_doc: Revert-verify for #4365: the retired `ims__Concept` key must not decide placement in `GenericAssetCreationService.getDefaultFolderPath`. Axes F1 / F2 in packages/core/tests/unit/services/GenericAssetCreationService.test.ts; the pre-existing 'should map class prefixes to correct default folders' table is the control for the surviving entries and was updated in the same diff. Measured 2026-09-26: control 106/106 green. ⛤ The key was REMOVED rather than renamed to the live `concept__Concept`: 0 assets are typed `ims__Concept` across all three canonical vaults (canary `concept__Concept` = 3192), and hardcoding "concepts" would reintroduce #4357 — real concepts live in three different assetspaces. ⛤ F1 is documentation, not an axis on the fix: it is green before and after, because the map never knew the live class. Saying so here is cheaper than letting a future reader count it as coverage.
